body.prose:
A whole says what it holds, and in what order. A part may be held by many wholes, each holding it fully, none of them its first home and none a borrowing: an audience's workflows are held by the audience as wholly as by the tree of workflows, and favorites hold what is placed there. What a whole is, its type says, and a reader reads it there: favorites gather what lives elsewhere, so what one placed there is shown as placed, not as what the thing is part of. A part is whole in itself wherever it is taken, so a whole taken away with its parts is whole, and one taken without the wholes that also hold its parts loses only what those wholes said.

That one holon has one owner, as OpenLight held, is left open on purpose. Nothing in the store needs it and nothing today asks for it, and starting with many owners can be narrowed later without breaking what was written, where starting with one could not be widened. Whoever meets a reason for a single owner meets it here.

An entry of something kept by time holds a reference to what keeps it instead, since such entries are ordered by a value, the day said or the moment visited, so adding one writes one holon and touches nothing else.

*Favorites as a place for things that exist from elsewhere, a shortcut, the author's, 2026-11-04, its type saying so the session's. Many owners the author's lean, 2026-11-04, from open-endedness and resonance with reality, which he names a gut feeling; that the store gives no reason to forbid it agreed the same day; the single owner left open by his word, so that it's clear in case we ever stumble upon the answer or someone else does. Reversibility the session's reason. A brief holds its children, a visit belongs instead, the author's, 2026-11-02.*
body.title: A part stands whole in many wholes
